description: Generates a CI workflow that produces an SBOM (software bill of materials, CycloneDX JSON) on every build, on GitHub Actions or a GitLab CI pipeline, for npm (Node.js), pip or Poetry (Python), Maven or Gradle (Java), Go or Cargo (Rust) projects. Returns a ready-to-commit workflow or job with actions pinned to commit SHAs and the generator version. Covers no other CI systems or ecosystems; for reading an existing SBOM: sbom_summarize.

ci.description: CI system or pipeline: github (GitHub Actions workflow) or gitlab (GitLab CI/CD job).

ecosystem.description: Package manager or language of the project: npm (Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript), pip or poetry (Python), maven or gradle (Java, Kotlin), go (Go modules), cargo (Rust).

name: sbom_ci_snippet
title: Generate SBOM steps for CI
